title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 2.00 (quiet) at 22:00 UTC on 24 September 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 9 月 24 日 22:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 2.00（平靜）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp is 2.00 (2Z) at 22:00 UTC on 24 September. The 22:00 hour is complete (60 samples through 22:59; hour-start 2.00/2Z, hour-end 2.33/2P). Last-180 maximum is 2.67 (first at 2026-09-24 20:00 UTC; label 3M). Published-window maximum is 3.00 (first at 2026-09-24 17:14 UTC; label 3Z). Window start 2026-09-24 17:02 UTC (358 samples). estimated_kp remains below 5.0. The 23:00 UTC hour has not started in the public file.
summary.zh: 最後可靠整點估計 Kp 為 2.00（2Z），取樣 2026-09-24 22:00 UTC。22:00 時段已收滿 60 筆（至 22:59，時段初 2.00／2Z、時段末 2.33／2P）。近 180 筆最大 2.67（最先見於 2026-09-24 20:00 UTC；標籤 3M）；公開窗最大 3.00（最先見於 2026-09-24 17:14 UTC；標籤 3Z）。窗起點 2026-09-24 17:02 UTC（358 筆）。estimated_kp 仍低於 5.0。公開檔尚未出現 23:00 UTC 時段。

evidence.method: Read the public 1-minute estimated planetary K-index JSON. Use the latest published hour-start minute of a completed hour that is not a trailing incomplete placeholder (22:00 UTC on 24 September). Report last-180 and full published-window maxima.
evidence.limitations: estimated_kp is a near-real-time estimate, not the final observatory Kp. The public file is a rolling ~6-hour window and older samples drop off. Hour-start 22:00 UTC is 2.00/2Z; the hour ends 2.33/2P at 22:59. The 23:00 UTC hour on 24 September has not appeared yet.

title.en: M4.6 earthquake 155 km NW of Ternate, Indonesia on 24 September 2026.

summary.en: USGS M4.5+ day feed: mb 4.6, depth about 48.469 km. Current day-feed maximum is mww 5.3 (us6000tx9u, 15 km SSW of Hilvan, Turkey).
summary.zh: USGS M4.5+ 一日饋送：mb 4.6，深度約 48.469 公里。一日饋送目前最大為 mww 5.3（us6000tx9u，土耳其希爾萬西南偏南約 15 公里）。

evidence.method: Added from the public USGS all-day M4.5+ GeoJSON feed when the event first appeared in the rolling 24-hour window.
evidence.limitations: Magnitudes and locations can be revised by USGS. The day feed only retains recent M4.5+ events.
